title: Kevin Stefanski on Jessie Bates trade: Falcons aren't punting on the season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kevin Stefanski on Jessie Bates trade: Falcons aren't punting on the season
sources.description: The Falcons traded veteran safety Jessie Bates to the Jaguars today, which some might see as a sign that the Falcons don't see themselves as contenders and are looking ahead at 2027.
